name: Vlerick Business School

class_size.cohort: current cohort (page read 2026-10-13, cohort year not stated)

program.note: 10 months (September - June), Brussels campus, one intake per year; next edition starts 1 September 2027.

tuition_total.note: Includes tuition, electives, textbooks, career services and coaching, campus facilities, alumni membership, FT digital subscription. A web-search extract of an older version of the page showed EUR 43,000.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No separate mandatory fee. International study course (Singapore or South Africa) not included: school estimates EUR 2,000-3,000 for flights, visas, accommodation. Optional instalment plan: EUR 250 admin fee.

living_budget_total.note: School gives monthly range EUR 1,200-1,700; 10-month totals are computed by us (10 x monthly). No single figure published.

scholarship.note: 'Full-time MBA scholarships range from 5% to 50% of the tuition fee.' Flemish SME e-wallet subsidy discontinued from 1 January 2027.

base_salary.note: No post-MBA salary published; only '76% salary increase' (cohort, basis and statistic not stated).

employment.note: Vlerick publishes no Full-time MBA employment report (no PDF found on vlerick.com or via search on 2026-10-13). Headline figures only, without cohort: 85% employed within six months, 75% employed in Europe, 65% found a job through Vlerick activities, 76% salary increase, 100+ recruitment partners.

profile.note: 35 cohort size, 88% international, 40% female, 32 average age. GMAT minimum 600 (or VBAT/GRE).

notes: No salary published: exclude from salary-based ROI ranking, keep cost data. FT Global MBA 2026 rank not found on an official or extract source (school page shows '#31 FT European Business School Ranking', undated) -> not recorded.
